items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: So, we added Jesse to the band.

ctx.x: Hang that action. If I'm over, I was busy. Yeah.

And, another time Jesse came over, so I said, well, if he's willing to play for nothing, I say, if there's something in the sight where his money is concerned, I may as well get in there. So, we added Jesse to the band. All right, fine.
